svg.title: A clear summer afternoon over Lake Ontario: a flat sky-base field with four soft cumulus banks, stepping to sky-light in the last 50 rows. The one band step is at world y 910, behind the opaque water of layer-30-harbour (from world 900), which is the layer kept beside this one at every tier including low, so no hard step can show against open sky. Row 0 is sky-base, the level theme sky, for the top-band seam. World y 0..960; every cloud is inside x 120..960 so the extreme columns stay flat band colour for the desktop side panel. Every colour is from palette.json.
